name: rosetta-anaprimes
code:
use default

let sieve_limit = 10_000_000
let composite = LIST(sieve_limit)

for _ in 0..sieve_limit do
    composite.add(false)
od

for candidate in 2..sieve_limit do
    if !composite[candidate] /\ candidate <= sieve_limit / candidate then
        let multiple mut = candidate * candidate

        while multiple < sieve_limit do
            composite[multiple] = true
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

digit_signature(value: int) -> string => "{value}" |> sort() |> join("")

report(bound: int) is
    let groups =
        (2..bound)
            |> filter(candidate => !composite[candidate])
            |> group_by(digit_signature)

    let largest = groups.values |> map(members => members.count) |> max()

    if let size = largest then
        let winner =
            groups.values
                |> filter(members => members.count == size)
                |> min_by(members => members[0])

        if let group = winner then
            write_line("  below {bound,10:N0}: {size,4} anaprimes, "
                       "from {group[0]:N0} to {group[size - 1]:N0}")
        fi
    fi
si

write_line("largest anagram group of primes:")

[1_000, 10_000, 100_000, 1_000_000, 10_000_000] |> each(report)
